verdict.rationale:
Temporal's Signal/Query/Update messaging (temporal-docs-6) combined with durable execution guarantees (temporal-docs-1) let a Workflow block indefinitely awaiting external input, and Temporal explicitly documents this pattern for agentic use cases ('wait on humans... pick up exactly where they left off after a failure', temporal-docs-9). Activities/retries and crash-proof resumption further reinforce that a paused workflow survives hours/days of waiting.
Missing for 10: a concrete worked example or independent/hands-on report specifically demonstrating a human-approval pause-and-resume workflow (evidence is docs-only, general community feedback doesn't address this exact pattern).
